t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said to avoid the blue, pink and red gnomes. They said the yellow gnome in round 3 and 4 was good.

vb_textbox.text: The amount of points you receive from each gnome is constantly changing. When a gnome is giving you only a few points, switch to the other coloured gnome and you should get more from that one. If you recieve a high amount of points from a gnome then for at least a few goes that gnome should give high points. After a few goes of being high, switch to the other gnome as the amount of points the gnome gives will go down again
